page.title: New competitor study
page.intro: Strata reads your website to understand your market, then lets you add competitors yourself — sources you enter are trusted right away. AI suggestions are available if you want a head start, but nothing about tracking a competitor requires them.

discovery.compareProfile: Comparing your profile against the market
discovery.filterDuplicates: Filtering out duplicates and unlikely matches

cultural.weighFit: Weighing cultural fit against your target countries
cultural.workOutFactors: Working out benefits, difficulties, and success factors

channels.checkFeeds: Checking each competitor’s site for a feed
channels.searchAccounts: Searching the web for their real accounts and hashtags
channels.askModel: Asking the model for X, LinkedIn, Threads, Facebook, and Instagram accounts, hashtags, and keywords to monitor
channels.searchReviews: Searching for review and discussion pages

business.title: Tell us about your business
business.hint: The website matters most — we read it to work out which market you are in and how you position yourself. Everything after this is judged against that, so a real site gives much better competitors than a description alone.
business.label: Business
business.searchPlaceholder: Search a business you've studied before…
business.noPast: No previous business profiles yet — switch to “Create new” above.
business.reusing: Reusing {{name}}’s market context — no re-scraping or AI wait needed. You can still edit it on the next step.
business.targetCountriesCarriedHint: carried over from that business — edit for this study
business.targetCountriesHint: optional — leave blank to search globally
business.name: Business name
business.descriptionPlaceholder: What you sell, who buys it, which markets you care about.
business.footReuse: Reusing a saved profile skips the website read entirely.
business.footRead: Reading your site takes about 20-40 seconds — or skip that and write the context yourself.

context.readPages_one: Read {{count}} page from your site ({{chars}} characters). Check the context below — competitors are found from it.
context.readPages_other: Read {{count}} pages from your site ({{chars}} characters). Check the context below — competitors are found from it.
context.title: What we understood
context.hint: Edit anything that is off. This is the description competitors get matched against and that every “how does this affect us” judgement is measured by.
context.languageMismatch: This saved market context was generated in another language. Re-run it to generate the content in your current language.

cultural.title: How will you fit in?
cultural.hint: Optional — an AI assessment of how well your business fits the culture(s) you’re targeting: what would help you succeed, the benefits of competing there, the difficulties you’d likely face, and other insights worth knowing. Skip this and continue any time.
cultural.languageMismatch: This saved analysis was generated in another language. Re-run it to generate the content in your current language.

competitors.addHint: Add the companies you compete with directly. Sources you enter here are trusted immediately and start scraping right away.
competitors.suggestTitle: Not sure who else to add?
competitors.suggestHint: Optional — AI compares your profile against the market and suggests competitors to review. Track the ones you want, and their channels are found automatically.
competitors.trackedSummary: {{tracked}} tracked. Channels are found and used immediately once a competitor is tracked, manual or AI-suggested.
competitors.emptyHint: Add one above, or suggest some with AI.
competitors.competesInTitle: Where this competitor actually competes with your business
competitors.unverifiedTitle: Tracked, but a live web check couldn't confirm this company exists — worth a manual look.

channels.title: Review channels
channels.hint: Every channel found for your tracked competitors is listed below and already included — discard any that aren’t actually theirs, or add one yourself if something’s missing.
channels.emptyHint: Go back and track at least one competitor first.

schedule.title: Keep it current
schedule.hint_one: {{count}} competitor ready to track. Re-scrape their sources on a schedule, using the same pipeline scheduler as the rest of Strata.
schedule.hint_other: {{count}} competitors ready to track. Re-scrape their sources on a schedule, using the same pipeline scheduler as the rest of Strata.
schedule.windowHintScheduled: optional — end date follows your repeat schedule when start is set
schedule.windowExplainScheduled: Optional — scopes which article publish dates get pulled in, kept {{window}} wide to match “{{interval}}” above when a start date is set. Leave the start date blank to pull in articles from any date instead.
schedule.windowExplain: Optional — scopes which article publish dates get pulled in. Leave blank to pull in articles from any date.
